channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: RBA set to raise interest rates in September as markets assess the next move
item.description: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) is widely expected to raise the Official Cash Rate (OCR) by 25 basis points (bps) to 4.60% from 4.35% on Tuesday, after keeping rates unchanged at its previous two meetings

item.title: Euro consolidates above 1.1350, seems vulnerable near late July lows amid bullish USD
item.description: The EUR/USD pair is seen consolidating around the 1.1365-1.1370 region during the Asian session on Tuesday and trading near its lowest level since July 28, touched the previous day.

item.title: British Pound softens to near 1.3250 as elevated US yields outweigh BoE’s hawkish tone
item.description: The GBP/USD pair loses ground to near 1.3250 during the early Asian trading hours on Tuesday. US Treasury yields ‌remain above 5% at multi-decade highs, supporting the US Dollar (USD) against the British Pound (GBP). Traders will keep an eye on the Fedspeak later on Tuesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD drops to near $60.50 amid surging oil, Treasury yields
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) continues to lose ground after registering over 5% losses in the previous day, trading around $60.60 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Tuesday. Non-yielding Silver price declined as ongoing uncertainty surrounding US-Iran negotiations kept oil prices elevated.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7411 vs. 6.7399 previous
item.description: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead on Tuesday at 6.7411 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7399 and 6.7177 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Canadian Dollar slumps to its lowest level since July 9, eyes 1.4200 vs bullish USD
item.description: The USD/CAD pair prolongs a three-week-old upward trajectory, rising to its highest level since July 9 and closer to the 1.4200 mark during the Asian session on Tuesday amid a bullish US Dollar (USD).

item.title: WTI inches up above $92.00 on Qatari-mediated US-Iran talks, Saudi pipeline restart
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $92.05 during the early Asian trading hours on Tuesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar steadies near its lows as RBNZ hike bets keep building
item.description: Five straight weekly declines have left NZD/USD at its lowest since late June. Monday's low near 0.5650 matched Thursday's and Friday's, and the pair closed just above it with a small gain.

item.title: Iran’s Araghchi says if US wants deal or peace, Tehran has offered solution
item.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said on Monday that Tehran discussed proposals with Qatari mediators that are to be put to the United States (US), IRNA reported. He added that the US response will be conveyed to Iran through the Qatari mediators.

item.title: Japanese Yen flatlines as Friday's rebound on Trump's concern holds
item.description: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MoF) reports on Wednesday how much Yen it bought between August 27 and September 28, which will show whether the rate check reported on September 18 turned into real money.

item.title: Gold tumbles below $4.150 as US bond yields, oil prices rise
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) falls to near $4,125 during the early Asian session on Tuesday. The precious metal faces some selling pressure as rising US Treasury yields and expectations of further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes sap demand for the non-yielding metal.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Trendline caps recovery as range holds
item.description: The Pound-Yen cross-pair finds support near 207.60 and bounces towards a daily high of 208.99 before settling at around 208.66, gaining 0.14%.

item.title: Australian Dollar holds above 0.70 as RBA hike becomes a done deal
item.description: The Aussie Dollar dives 0.10% versus the US Dollar as market sentiment deteriorates amid fading US-Iran peace hopes, pushing US bond yields higher while US equity markets fall. Also, price action remained subdued, ahead of the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) monetary policy decision.

item.title: Euro slips back to its summer low as ECB President Lagarde urges measured hikes
item.description: Traders betting on a faster European Central Bank (ECB) got pushback from ECB President Lagarde on Monday, and EUR/USD fell back to its late-July low near 1.1350. The pair closed just above 1.1350, three sessions after it broke below 1.1400.

item.title: Pound Sterling edges higher as the BoE's deputy governors lean toward a hike
item.description: The Bank of England (BoE) held the UK's Bank Rate at 3.75% on September 17 by six votes to three, and half of the six who voted to hold now say a hike may be needed.

item.title: Mexican Peso plunges as US-Mexico interest rate differential reduces
item.description: The Mexican Peso collapses against the US Dollar, depreciating on Monday as market mood sours amid stalled US-Iran talks. News headlines reported that a potential agreement is near, but officials denied the progress.

item.title: Dow Jones Industrial Average gives back Friday's rally on a Boeing delay
item.description: A software bug at Boeing (BA) cost the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) more points than a record $150 billion buyback at Nvidia (NVDA) put back. The index closed just under 51,500 on Monday, handing back about two-thirds of Friday's rally.

item.title: Gold price crashes as 2007-era yields trigger brutal sell-off
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) begins the week on the back foot, tanking over 3.4% on Monday as US Treasury yields soar and Oil prices remain elevated despite falling from daily highs amid mixed news headlines about a potential US-Iran deal. The XAU/USD trades at $4,139 after peaking at $4,280.

item.title: Japanese Yen trades cautiously as intervention risk clashes with Fed rate hike bets
item.description: USD/JPY trades little changed around 157.25 on Monday as the US Dollar (USD) also holds steady near recent highs, with traders weighing Middle East developments and the risk of Japanese intervention.

item.title: Forex Today: The RBA and Fedspeak grab all the attention
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) has stated the week with slight gains, resuming its recent uptrend and leaving behind Friday’s hiccup.

item.title: US 10-year yield revisits 2007 heights as curve flirts with inversion
item.description: US Treasury yields climb on Monday as energy prices remain high, amid US President Donald Trump's rejection of a peace agreement with Tehran.

item.title: Crude Oil round-trips between a rejected Iran plan and a sanctions offer
item.description: President Donald Trump's rejection of Iran's seven-day plan for the Strait of Hormuz lifted Crude Oil to its best level since Thursday, and the whole rise was gone after a Saudi pipeline restart and a US offer of sanctions relief.

item.title: Fed’s Cook: AI, Iran risks could keep inflation pressures high
item.description: Federal Reserve (Fed) Governor Lisa Cook said in a speech in Oakland, California, that the number and magnitude of future adjustments to the Fed funds rate will depend on inflation and labor market data.

item.title: US President Trump to ease sanctions on Iran over nuclear progress
item.description: Al Jazeera reported on Monday that US President Donald Trump is prepared to ease sanctions on Iran and to unfreeze its assets in exchange for progress on nuclear talks.

item.title: USD: Speculative longs steady as Fed hikes – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s RaboResearch Global Economics & Markets FX Strategy team notes that USD net long speculative positions were broadly unchanged, with both longs and shorts rising modestly. The Federal Reserve raised its overnight policy rate by 25bp on September 16, matching expectations.

item.title: British Pound defies US yields surge as BoE hike bets build
item.description: The Pound Sterling (GBP) registers modest gains of 0.18% on Monday even as US Treasury yields soar, with the US 10-year T-note rising over 10 basis points, underpinning the Greenback. At the time of writing, the GBP/USD pair trades at 1.3252.

item.title: Gold tumbles over 3.5% as Fed rate-hike bets, surging US Treasury yields weigh
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) remains under strong selling pressure on Monday, down over 3.5% as elevated Oil prices reinforce expectations of further Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hikes. At the time of writing, XAU/USD trades around $4,121, its lowest level since August 5.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD plunges 5% as momentum indicators turn bearish
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) falls around 5% on Monday, slipping to its lowest level since early August.

item.title: GBP: Shorts at highs as Pound tracks Oil-led USD rally – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank highlights that GBP net short positions have risen over 40%, reaching their highest level since August. The Bank of England kept the Bank Rate unchanged at 3.75% on September 18, in line with expectations.

item.title: Euro struggles as Fed rate-hike bets overshadow ECB tightening expectations
item.description: EUR/USD trades on the back foot on Monday, pressured by a stronger US Dollar (USD) as the US-Iran stalemate keeps Oil prices elevated, pushing US Treasury yields higher and strengthening expectations of further Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hikes.
